 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Eric Glyman, co-founder and CEO of Ramp. Ramp is best known for its corporate cards, but it has a range of software products to help finance teams save time and money. The business has grown rapidly since its founding in 2019 and was last valued at $8 billion. Eric and I discussed Ramp's initial marketing wedge, how the business has dealt with such fast growth, and why they hold Stablecoins on their balance sheet. Please enjoy my conversation with Eric Glyman.

 The Inspiration Behind Ramp 
 Patrick 
Eric, I'd love to begin our conversation by hearing what this industry that you're building in was like when you first approached it. What were the things, looking back on the early days, that were most notably awry about the existing incumbent solutions that motivated you to want to build a company here in the first place?
